claims.statement: For d=2n>=4, if Phi:M_d->M_d is a unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint USp(2n)-covariant channel with a two-output CPTP extension having both marginals Phi, then Psi_d(X)=(X+Tr(X)I)/(d+1) is one full-domain entanglement-breaking comparator satisfying id-Psi_d <=_HS 2(id-Phi). Equivalently, for every positive Hermitian-space dual Q, Tr_HS(Q Phi) <= (Tr_HS(Q)+Tr_HS(Q Psi_d))/2.
assumptions: The representation is the defining complex representation of compact USp(2n), with d=2n>=4.
Phi is CPTP, unital, trace preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint, and group covariant.
A CPTP two-output extension with identical one-site marginals exists; the extension need not initially be output-swap symmetric.
The order is positivity on the real Hilbert space of Hermitian matrices, not complete positivity.
claims.support_statement: For invariant Q=q0 Pi0+a Pi_+ + b Pi_- with q0,a,b>=0, the full three-copy star has lambda_max=2q0 + d(d+2)a/2 + (d^2-4)b/2. Its maximum equals Tr_HS(Q)+sup_EB Tr_HS(Q EB). The output-antisymmetric contraction block is included.
claims.novelty_boundary: The d=4 cloner and pure-state estimation comparator are standard U(4)-covariant constructions. The bounded primary-source audit found no exact match for the common-comparator/all-mixed support inequality, but it is not systematic and supports no novelty or priority claim. No claim is made for noncovariant channels or higher Clifford-form representations.
claims.costs: No data acquisition or sampling is used. The proof is representation theoretic and the symbolic check verifies displayed polynomial identities; neither provides an efficient physical implementation of the broadcaster or measurement.
claims.falsifier: A defect in the symplectic Choi identification, contraction completeness, antisymmetric-block trace/determinant domination, or legal twirled-Choi marginal argument invalidates the proof. Independently, a compatible channel satisfying the assumptions but violating the displayed common-comparator order is a direct counterexample.
claims.next_gate: Analyze a mixed higher-form spinor action with at least three nontrivial irreducible operator sectors; calculate full canonical-EB support and all output-swap star blocks, or find a legal mixed-dual violation. The unrestricted noncovariant dimension-free constant remains open.

claims.statement: In d=4 the symmetric Spin(5)-covariant broadcaster at the isotropic boundary is the standard U(4) universal 1-to-2 cloner with marginal transfer 3/5 on both nontrivial operator sectors; the full-domain EB comparator is the standard pure-state estimation channel (X+Tr(X)I)/5.
assumptions: The Spin(5) representation is its four-dimensional spinor representation, isomorphic to the defining representation of Sp(2).
claims.novelty_boundary: The cloner and estimation map are standard. The prior audit does not establish or refute novelty of the mixed-support theorem; no priority claim is made.
claims.costs: Closed-form finite-dimensional maps; no acquisition costs.
claims.falsifier: A mismatch in the cloner marginal formula, Kraus-product extremality computation, or orbit second moment.
claims.next_gate: Keep standard cloning/state-estimation ingredients credited and distinguish them from any new compatibility/support comparison.

checks: The antisymmetric contraction block is self-adjoint in its positive Gram metric.
Its Gram determinant, gap trace, and gap determinant equal the displayed formulas.
The complement bound factors nonnegatively in both regions b>=a and a>=b.
The star maximum equals Hilbert-Schmidt trace plus exact invariant EB support.

spin5_exact_certificate.scope: Exact d=4 vector and bivector characteristic-polynomial and top-eigenvalue checks only.
